content: Agent self-telemetry: token usage per session/agent/task for cost attribution; sudden token spikes are the first sign of a loop/runaway retry/bloated context; per-session anomaly detection (e.g. 10x expected tokens flagged); recursive tool-calling loops without system-level token controls exhaust budgets with no audit trail and no warning before billing damage; recommended controls = per-agent/workflow budgets, caching, context trimming, alert/cutoff thresholds.
